jobs.description:
Technical Product Manager – Integrations & Connectors (m/f/d)

Your mission

Construction companies run their tenders across many tools. Your mission is to make Cosuno the place where it all comes together. Tenders should flow into Cosuno automatically from the systems our customers already use, and results should flow back out without anyone lifting a finger. The deeper Cosuno sits in our customers' processes, the more value we create for them.

At the same time, AI assistants like Claude and Gemini are becoming how people work. You'll launch our first MCP server so that our customers can analyze their data and operate Cosuno straight from their AI assistant.


How you'll get there:

  • Get to know our customers. Your first weeks are all about listening. You'll talk to customers and find out what it takes for our REST API and connectors to become part of their daily work. Together with Engineering, Customer Success and Sales, you'll turn those insights into a clear roadmap. You'll also set up the tracking that shows how much of our customers' work flows in through integrations.

  • Launch the first API improvements and our first MCP server. You'll shape both, write the engineering tickets and roll them out to our first pilot customers, all within your first few months.

  • Decide what comes next. Once real usage data and pilot feedback come in, you'll make clear recommendations on what to build and decide on the way forward together with our CTO and Head of Product.

  • Make integrations the norm. By the end of your first year, far more of our customers will run Cosuno connected to the tools they rely on, and you'll be the one who made it happen.

It's an ambitious plan, and that's what makes it fun: you'll see the impact of your work directly in our customers' day-to-day.

How we work:

  • Full ownership: You own integrations end to end, from the first customer conversation to the shipped feature. Engineering takes care of the implementation.

  • Close to the customer: You'll talk to customers constantly, mostly remotely, sometimes on-site across Germany.

  • Technical by nature: You'll read API docs, test endpoints yourself and discuss data models with engineers. You don't write production code.

  • AI-first: We use AI deeply in our product and in our daily work, and we expect you to do the same.

What you bring:

  • You've shaped an API from the product side. You've defined, together with customers and engineering, what a public API or integration of a SaaS product exposes: endpoints, data models, auth, permissions.

  • You're technical enough to go deep with engineers. Webhooks vs. polling, pagination, rate limits, OAuth: you can discuss trade-offs, and you test APIs yourself.

  • You find the real need. You've worked directly with customers, separated what they ask for from what they really need, and found what it takes for them to use an integration.

  • You write tickets engineers love. Clear scope, clear acceptance criteria, and a clear line on what's out of scope. You prioritize by impact, not by who shouts loudest.

  • You're fast. You ship in weeks, not quarters, and you build, learn and iterate in parallel.

  • You explain complex things simply, to a construction company's project manager as well as to internal stakeholders like our commercial teams or our management.

  • You live AI. You use LLM assistants and MCPs every day, and you've built your own automations.

  • You keep growing. You actively build your skills, and you seek and act on feedback.

  • Fluent German and English. Our customers are German construction companies who work in German. Our engineering team works in English.

  • Based in Germany and open to traveling to customers across the country.

  • Bonus points if you've helped build an MCP server that customers use, or if you know construction tech, ERP or estimating systems (e.g. RIB iTWO, SAP, Nevaris).

Why us?

  • Real impact: You'll shape how an entire industry connects its software and how AI agents work with it.

  • Competitive compensation: A salary above the market average.

  • Work-life balance: Work fully remotely from anywhere in Germany, or from our office in Berlin Kreuzberg, with flexible working hours.

  • Top-notch equipment: A new MacBook Pro.

  • A great team: Regular company off-sites and team events.

  • Job security: A permanent contract in a stable, well-funded company.

  • Growth & feedback: An open feedback culture with regular 1:1s and development conversations with our Head of Product.

About us

Cosuno – Revolutionizing construction through technology.

 

We are Cosuno – a fast-growing tech startup that is making the construction industry more efficient and transparent with our digital platform for tenders and procurement processes. Our goal: to solve the most complex challenges in the industry with innovation and simplicity.

Artificial intelligence is the key to our solution: it analyzes millions of price data points and helps construction companies create precise and efficient bids. This not only saves our customers time but also helps them avoid unnecessary costs.

But for us, it's not just about technology – it's about the people who drive it. At Cosuno, you will work with creative minds who are reshaping the construction industry. We believe in diversity because we know that the best ideas come from different perspectives. An inclusive work environment is a given for us.

 

Join us – Build the future of construction.

Post-doctorant.e : "Simulation numérique 3D de l’infusion de composites à fibres naturelles" - CDD 12 mois

ENGLISH VERSION

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.

Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.

L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

Bienvenue dans l’univers des matériaux du futur !

Au centre Science des Matériaux et des Structures (SMS), rattaché au Laboratoire Georges Friedel (unité mixte de recherche CNRS), on décortique la matière pour mieux la maîtriser. Alliages métalliques, céramiques, composites… ici, on explore le lien entre procédés, microstructures et propriétés des matériaux.

Grâce à des outils de caractérisation avancée et des modèles multi-échelles, nos enseignants-chercheurs inventent le concept de « Material by design » : concevoir les matériaux dès l’atelier de recherche, pour une performance sur-mesure.

🧠 Vous aimez la science fondamentale qui change le réel ? C’est ici que ça se passe.

🎯 Description du poste - ce que nous attendons de vous

Ce post-doctorat s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet ANR PRME LINEN (Experimental and Numerical Characterisation of Flax Composite Manufacturing by Liquid Infusion: From Local Phenomena to Induced Properties), auquel participent plusieurs chercheurs de l’École des Mines de Saint-Étienne, avec pour objectif d’étudier l’élaboration de pièces structurales en matériaux composites à base de fibres de lin.

Ce post-doctorat, d’une durée de 12 mois est proposé pour développer la modélisation numérique de l’infusion de résine dans des préformes composites à fibres de lin. L’objectif est d’étudier, à l’échelle mésoscopique, l’influence de l’organisation anisotrope et hétérogène des torons de fibres sur l’écoulement de la résine. Le projet s’appuiera sur des simulations 3D par éléments finis, reposant sur un couplage Stokes-Darcy et la prise en compte d’un tenseur de perméabilité orthotrope. Une attention particulière sera portée à l’influence des variations locales de la fraction volumique de fibres sur la perméabilité, les chemins préférentiels d’écoulement et les effets capillaires. Les simulations seront réalisées avec le code éléments finis Cœur (https://gitlab.emse.fr/bruchon/Coeur), en s’appuyant sur la bibliothèque PETSc et des solveurs itératifs préconditionnés adaptés aux problèmes de grande taille. Dans un premier temps, des architectures idéalisées de type unidirectionnel, quasi-unidirectionnel et tissé seront étudiées à l’aide d’une représentation par Level-Set. Dans un second temps, lorsque cela sera possible, des mésostructures réalistes seront reconstruites à partir d’images µ-CT.

Le post-doctorant.e contribuera également au développement et à la validation de la stratégie numérique et travaillera en interaction étroite avec les travaux expérimentaux et numériques des autres tâches du projet.


🔍 Ce que nous recherchons

Une formation en mécanique numérique, mécanique des fluides, éléments finis ou calcul scientifique est recherchée.

Des compétences en C++/Python, calcul haute performance, PETSc, méthodes Level-Set ou traitement d’images 3D seront appréciées.

Vous vous reconnaissez dans les capacités et aptitudes suivantes :

· Capacité à travailler en équipe

· Capacité à dialoguer avec des interlocuteurs académiques et industriels

Data Analytics Intern

Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Join us as a Data Analytics Intern and help build the technical foundation that protects our 700,000+ customers. You'll join the Risk Analytics team, working closely with Vatsal Parekh to deliver reliable data, reporting and tools that help Risk & Compliance teams respond to regulators, auditors and internal controllers — while exploring how AI can make that work smarter.

Internship, ideal start January 2027
Planned duration: 6 months

➡️ In this internship, you will:
  • Handle real stakeholder requests: Deliver reliable SQL data extracts for regulatory reporting, audits and internal controls, owning daily "run" tickets with increasing autonomy.
  • Build and improve dashboards: Analyse data and create or enhance reporting dashboards and visualisations that Risk & Compliance teams actually use to steer activity and risk.
  • Maintain and develop technical tools: Apply and grow your SQL and/or Python skills to maintain and improve existing tools and code — you don't need to master both from day one.
  • Grow into a bigger project: Depending on your capabilities and team priorities, you may contribute to or take ownership of a longer-term technical project over the internship — scope to be confirmed with your manager.

➡️ What you can expect:
  • Visible impact: Your data and tools directly support how Risk & Compliance teams respond to regulators, internal auditors and controllers.
  • Close mentoring: You'll be mentored by Vatsal Parekh and Omayma Nayma, with weekly 1:1 check-ins and day-to-day support.
  • Room to grow: Your scope can expand as you demonstrate capability — there's no fixed ceiling on what you can take on beyond the daily tickets.
  • Modern, AI-native stack: Unlimited access to AI tools like Claude Code to accelerate your work.
  • Hybrid work in Paris: 2 days remote per week


➡️ About You:
  • Technical foundation: You're ideally an M2 / final-year student (gap-year candidates welcome) in Computer Science, Software or Computer Engineering, from an engineering school or a technically strong university programme — international universities welcome, provided your school can issue a convention de stage.
  • Practical skills: Python and/or SQL fluency. You write clean maintainable code and know how to structure a real project.
  • Communication: You are fluent in English and can clearly communicate your work with teammates and stakeholders.
  • Experience: A previous relevant data or engineering internship is a plus; so is experience with dashboards or maintaining existing tools.
  • Curiosity: You're interested in fintech and banking and willing to learn the compliance context. A dual technical/finance background is a bonus, not a must.
➡️ About your future Manager:

Your manager will be Vatsal Parekh, Lead Risk & Compliance Engineering at Qonto. He'll give you day-to-day context on how Risk Analytics supports regulators, auditors and internal controllers, while giving you room to build practical experience and take on more responsibility as you go.
  • His background? Vatsal spent close to a decade at Société Générale as Senior Regulatory Risk Manager and Global Product Owner for the Counterparty Credit Risk platform, leading a team across the Americas, Europe and Asia with direct exposure to ECB and Fed regulatory frameworks. He then moved into risk and compliance consulting at Tremau, managing a team of 10 delivering engagements for global e-commerce and social media platforms, before joining Qonto in 2026.
  • What he brings to the team? A combination of hands-on regulatory risk expertise, consulting-grade delivery rigor, and deep technical fluency — 10+ years of SQL, hands-on use of AI-assisted workflows, and a track record of building data and reporting processes from scratch. He gives the team both technical grounding and a first-hand read on what regulators and auditors actually need.

Enjoy the rest. Team events, snacks, and beverages.

Be yourself. An inclusive, supportive environment where everyone belongs.

Onboarding Specialist - Lyon

Salonkee est l'une des entreprises beauty-tech à la croissance la plus rapide en Europe. Nous aidons des milliers de salons à simplifier leurs opérations quotidiennes et à offrir une expérience client hors du commun.

Notre logiciel tout-en-un simplifie la prise de rendez-vous, les paiements et la gestion client, permettant ainsi aux professionnels de se concentrer sur l'essentiel : délivrer une prestation exceptionnelle. Nous sommes fiers de façonner l'avenir de l'industrie de la beauté grâce à l'innovation, la collaboration et une approche résolument humaine.

Après avoir digitalisé le secteur de la beauté dans plusieurs pays d'Europe, nous recherchons nos premiers commerciaux pour faire de la France une de nos plus grandes réussites.

 

L'opportunité

En tant qu’Onboarding Specialist, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans l’accompagnement de nos clients afin de leur garantir une expérience fluide et positive. Votre sens du service, votre approche proactive et votre capacité à résoudre les problèmes seront essentiels pour assurer la satisfaction de nos clients et contribuer au succès global de l’entreprise.

  • Intégration et formation : tu intègres et formes nos clients à l’utilisation de notre solution à travers des sessions de formation de 2 à 3 heures.

  • Conseil et expertise : tu conseilles et partages ton expertise produit afin d’aider les clients à tirer le meilleur parti de leur abonnement.

  • Point de contact privilégié : tu es le premier interlocuteur pour toute question ou demande client.

  • Formation : tu détiens un diplôme de bachelier ou tu justifies d'une expérience équivalente.

  • Expérience : tu as une première expérience réussie dans une fonction de gestion de comptes ou de relation client.

  • Esprit d'analyse : tu relies de solides capacités d'analyse à une approche créative pour la résolution de problèmes.

  • Excellent relationnel : tu sais instaurer une confiance immédiate et créer un lien fort avec des entrepreneurs indépendants.

  • Digital native : tu es à l'aise avec les outils SaaS et les environnements tech : la maîtrise d'un CRM est un vrai plus.

  • Langues : français natif. Un anglais professionnel est apprécié pour collaborer avec nos équipes internationales.

 

Ce que nous offrons

  • Véhicule de fonction + carte essence + badge télépéage

  • Organisation autonome. Tu gères ton agenda dans un cadre de confiance

  • 25 jours de congés + repos supplémentaire (sous conditions)

  • Mutuelle

  • Tickets-restaurant

  • Un parcours d'intégration structuré : formation produit, accompagnement terrain avec ton manager les premières semaines, et accès à l'expérience de nos équipes déjà en place dans 6 autres pays

  • L'opportunité de participer à une success story et d'avoir un impact tangible sur l'avenir du secteur de la beauté et du bien-être

  • Des événements d'entreprise réguliers pour renforcer la cohésion d'équipe et créer des opportunités de networking et de collaboration

 

Chez Salonkee, nous sommes convaincus que l'innovation s'épanouit dans un environnement où chacun se sent inclus et valorisé. Nous bâtissons une équipe diversifiée à l'image de l'industrie que nous servons : créative, passionnée et riche de perspectives variées. Peu importe qui tu es ou d'où tu viens, tu trouveras ici ta place pour grandir, contribuer et être toi-même.

 

Salonkee promeut l'égalité des chances et la diversité. Nous accueillons toutes les candidatures, indépendamment du genre, de l'origine, de l'âge, du handicap ou de l'identité.

Senior Counsel, France
jobs.description:
Senior Counsel, France

About the Team

OpenAI’s Legal team supports OpenAI’s mission by addressing complex legal issues arising from the development and deployment of AI. The team brings together expertise in commercial, corporate, employment, privacy, intellectual property, regulatory, tax and litigation matters, and works closely with teams across the company.

About the Role

We’re seeking an experienced, hands-on lawyer to serve as our country lawyer for France, providing broad legal support for our local office with a primary focus on regulatory and policy legal matters affecting OpenAI’s products, operations and business.

You will advise on French and EU regulatory developments, develop practical legal positions and recommendations, and support OpenAI’s engagement with French regulators and policymakers. Working closely with EMEA and global legal colleagues, as well as policy and regulatory affairs teams, you will take ownership of assigned French matters, translate complex legal questions into actionable advice and help ensure that our approach in France is consistent with OpenAI’s wider legal positions.

Alongside your primary focus, you will also provide broader French country legal support, coordinating with specialist teams on local business and operational matters.

We’re looking for someone who can take responsibility for matters, give practical advice, manage competing priorities and bring cross-functional work to a decision. You will work closely with EMEA and global legal colleagues, GA and Policy leaders, applying established specialist guidance, approval processes and escalation routes.

In this role, you will:

  • Advise on regulatory developments and their business implications. Assess existing and emerging French and EU laws, enforcement developments and policy proposals affecting OpenAI. Develop legal positions and practical recommendations, working with GA, Policy, Regulatory, Product, Privacy and other legal teams to translate requirements into action. Serve as a trusted legal partner to local leadership and business teams on the establishment, expansion and day-to-day operation of our French presence. Identify legal dependencies early and translate them into practical options and implementation plans.

  • Support regulatory and policy engagement. Partner with GA, Policy and legal colleagues to prepare for and participate in engagements with French and EU regulators, policymakers and local government. Develop legal analysis, briefing materials, consultation responses and legal input into policy positions, coordinating with the relevant EMEA and global teams.

  • Support French business initiatives. Advise on local partnerships, research and university collaborations, marketing, events and other commercial initiatives, working with Commercial, Product, IP, Privacy and Regulatory Legal as appropriate.

  • Provide coordinated French country legal support. Serve as a local legal partner on French business and operational matters, including local governance, office development, employment and workplace compliance. Identify legal requirements, involve the appropriate specialist teams and help take agreed actions through to implementation, maintaining clear ownership and alignment with OpenAI’s global operating framework.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have a law degree (Master 2 in Law, Bac+5, or equivalent) and substantial experience advising on French law, with the breadth to identify and manage issues across commercial, employment, corporate and operational matters.

  • Have relevant in-house and/or law firm, government or institutional legal experience, including work on regulatory engagement, policy development or enforcement matters.

  • Have experience interpreting complex legislation and policy proposals, developing clear legal recommendations, and preparing persuasive submissions, consultation responses or briefing materials.

  • Can combine regulatory judgment with practical country-level legal support, working across specialist teams and helping the business move from legal analysis to decisions and implementation.

  • Exercise sound judgment in unfamiliar areas, distinguish material risks from issues that can be managed within established guidance, and know when to involve specialist colleagues.

  • Communicate and negotiate effectively in French and English, and can explain complex legal issues clearly to business stakeholders and senior leaders.

  • Can manage a varied workload, prioritise according to business needs and legal risk, and maintain dependable coverage of French operational and business matters while progressing other assigned work.

  • Are interested in AI and emerging technologies, comfortable working through uncertainty and able to develop expertise as products, markets and legal requirements evolve.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link.

Senior Backend Developer (Go) — Full Remote, European Timezones Only (UTC−1 to UTC+3)

Read this first — two non-negotiables

  1. Go is the job, not a bonus skill. We're only considering candidates with 5+ years of hands-on, production experience in Go. If Go isn't (one of) your primary languages, this role won't be a match — and we'd rather save you the time.

  2. You must live in a European timezone (UTC−1 to UTC+3). This is a hard requirement. Applications from outside this range won't be considered, regardless of how strong the profile is.

Still with us? Great — here's why this role is worth your attention.

Who we are

We're Jobtome (https://weare.jobtome.com/) — an HR Tech company building the modern web applications that companies use to run complex hiring and recruitment workflows at scale.

Our products are highly interactive, data-driven, and built for real-world usage — not demos. We work with a strong product mindset, short feedback loops, and a pragmatic engineering culture: quality, ownership, and code we're still proud of a year from now.

The role

You'll join our engineering team as a Senior Go Backend Developer and take real ownership of critical backend systems and services — not ticket-pushing, actual ownership.

You'll design, build, and evolve the backend services that power our products, weigh in on architectural decisions, improve system reliability, and help shape how backend engineering is done across the company.

This is a hands-on senior role: you'll write production Go every day and be deeply involved in technical decisions that have real impact.


Quick reminder before the details

5+ years of production Go experience — required Based in a European timezone (UTC−1 to UTC+3)

What you'll do

  • Design, build, and maintain backend services written in Go

jobs.title: Junior Computational Geometry Engineer
jobs.description:
Junior Computational Geometry Engineer
SAEKI - Manufacturing at software speed

Europe's defense industrial base cannot respond at the speed modern conflict requires. Legacy suppliers operate on month-long timelines. Tribal knowledge is retiring. Supply chains are fragile. SAEKI is building the operating system for autonomous factories - the infrastructure that lets Europe manufacture mission-critical components at software speed.


The Role

As a Junior Computational Geometry Engineer, you work on the geometry core of our Manufacturing Intelligence stack: the engine that takes an arbitrary customer CAD model, reasons about how to build it, and then proves that we built it right.
You start on well-scoped parts of that engine, next to the engineers who built it, and grow into owning them. Your code runs in the factory.


What We're Looking For

  • Foundations. Degree in computer science, mathematics, mechanical engineering or a related field, with real depth in geometry, linear algebra and numerics. Internships, thesis work or serious side projects count. We do not expect years of production experience.
  • B-rep Basics. You are comfortable with topology, NURBS, meshes and point clouds. You may never have shipped a robust boolean, and you still understand why floating-point robustness destroys naive implementations, and you want to learn how the field handles it.
  • Kernel Exposure. You have worked with a geometry kernel and mesh libraries in at least one project: OpenCASCADE, CGAL, libigl, Open3D, PCL, Parasolid or comparable.
  • Technical Ability. Solid modern C++ (17+) plus Python for tooling and rapid iteration. Rust is welcome. You write code others can read, test and maintain.
  • Manufacturing Curiosity. You want to understand what happens once geometry meets a spindle, a nozzle or a fixture. CNC, additive or metrology exposure is a bonus, never a requirement.
  • First Principles Thinker. You reason by physics and mathematics, not analogy. When an algorithm fails on a real part, you dig until you know whether the bug sits in the code, the model or the assumption.
  • Learning Speed. You take direct feedback, apply it immediately, and close your own knowledge gaps without waiting to be taught.
  • Industrial Grit. You want to stand next to the machine in Germany and watch your output run. The feedback loop between your code and cutting metal is the point.
  • On-site. Ability to work in person at our HQ in Zurich, Switzerland.


What we're not looking for

  • Researchers who want to publish and hand off. You ship.
  • CAD users. This is a role for people who build the tools, not drive them.
  • Engineers who need a clean spec. The problem is defined by the part, the machine, and the customer - you'll help define it.
  • People who treat “it works on the test model” as done. Real customer CAD is broken, degenerate, and adversarial. That is the job.
  • Engineers who are uncomfortable with ambiguity or rapidly changing priorities.


What we offer

  • Mission: Rebuild the industrial sovereignty of the West. Your work directly enables production of mission-critical hardware for defense and space.
  • Total Ownership: High-stakes autonomy in your domain. You own both the problems and the solutions - and have the authority to execute.
  • The Environment: Access to a 8,000 m² state-of-the-art facility featuring 5-axis CNCs, industrial robots, and industrial 3D printers. Your algorithms run on real hardware from day one.
  • The Team: "Special Forces" model. Everyone senior, everyone ships. No politics, no bureaucracy. Direct feedback, high standards.
  • Compensation: Competitive salary + meaningful equity.
  • Location: Zurich HQ, with occasional time at Factory ONE in Munich.



Apply

  • Resume: Focus on the geometry work you have actually done. Thesis, internships, projects, coursework.
  • GitHub/Portfolio: Show us the hardest problem you have solved. Code, a write-up, or a part that came off a machine because of you.
  • Coverletter: Why this mission? Why now? What would you build first?

Dans le cadre du projet ANR NET4AI, qui vise à rendre les infrastructures utilisées pour entraîner et opérer des modèles d'IA générative plus efficaces (observabilité, communications collectives, efficacité énergétique), nous recrutons une post-doctorante ou un post-doctorant au sein de notre département Automatique Productique et Informatique (DAPI), équipe STACK.

 

Sous la responsabilité scientifique de Remous-Aris KOUTSIAMANIS et en collaboration avec les chercheurs, ingénieurs et partenaires du consortium Net4AI et du projet SLICES-FR, vous définirez et mettrez en œuvre une méthodologie expérimentale reproductible pour l'évaluation des mécanismes Net4AI. Vous concevrez et développerez des briques logicielles d'automatisation (notamment via EnOSlib) pour le déploiement de charges GenAI distribuées. Enfin, vous réaliserez des campagnes expérimentales et contribuerez activement aux publications scientifiques et logiciels open source du projet.

Consultez la fiche de poste détaillée


✔️ Vous maîtrisez parfaitement le langage Python ainsi que les outils de développement collaboratif tels que Git, l'intégration continue et les tests automatisés. jobs.title: Senior Data Center Hardware Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Data Center Hardware Engineer

About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The mission

You will be the reference point for the most complex hardware interventions across our sites.

Mistral's compute is our largest investment and the foundation of frontier AI in Europe. As a Senior Data Center Hardware Engineer (L4-L5), you own the interventions that require the highest level of technical expertise: multi-node failures in production, full-rack deployments of GPU-dense systems, and vendor escalations where you speak as the technical authority for our sites.

You'll work end-to-end — compute, storage, interconnect, power and cooling interfaces — across our data center footprint, raising the bar on reliability as our capacity grows. This is a hands-on senior IC role: deep technical leadership and mentorship, no direct line management.

Location: Based at one of our data centers in the Paris region, with occasional visits to our other sites as needed.

 

What you'll do

  • Lead complex interventions — vendor-level and multi-node operations in production: full rack builds and bring-up, GPU-dense platform deployment (H100/H200-class and next-gen, including liquid-cooled racks), intricate recabling, post-restart diagnosis. You own the plan, the risk assessment, and the rollback.

  • Own vendor management — coordinate repairs, part replacements and escalations directly with hardware vendors; hold them to their SLAs; drive proactive fixes from failure trends.

  • Diagnose at depth — correlate symptoms across compute, storage, interconnect and cooling; read BMC/IPMI consoles, OS logs and crash dumps; methodical root-cause analysis that ends in concrete corrective actions.

  • Deploy and validate — structured bring-up and validation of new racks and platforms; work with networking and infrastructure teams to take installations from delivery to production-ready.

  • Lift the team — mentor and pair with L1–L3 engineers on live operations; turn your knowledge into SOPs, checklists and training material; propose and build small automation (Python/Bash) to shorten MTTR.

  • Work the facility interface — partner with critical facilities/engineering ops on power, cooling (air and liquid), PDU and monitoring (BMS/EPMS) boundaries; enforce ESD/LOTO/PPE and audit-ready change discipline everywhere.

  • Own spares & reliability — plan spares strategy, track fleet failure trends, and run proactive vendor actions before incidents happen.

 

About you

  • 6+ years in data center / server hardware or L2/L3 hardware support, including complex hands-on work in production environments (HPC/AI/cloud at scale strongly preferred).

  • End-to-end hardware expertise: CPU/memory/PCIe (incl. accelerators), NICs, PSUs, drives, network, power and cooling interfaces (DLC included); strong judgment on when and how to escalate.

  • Diagnostics depth: confident with BMC/IPMI logs, Linux logs and CLI checks; structured root-cause analysis.

  • Deployment experience: you've taken racks from delivery to production, with concrete examples to show for it.

  • Vendor fluency: you've managed hardware vendors — RMAs, field replacements, escalations — to concrete outcomes.

  • Impeccable safety and discipline: ESD/LOTO/PPE without exception; clean, labeled, auditable work.

  • Communication & mentoring: clear status updates and handovers; able to coach engineers during live incidents with composure.

  • Mobility: willing to visit our other sites in the Paris region as needed.

 

Nice to have

  • GPU-dense platform experience: NVIDIA H-series (H100/H200) or GB-series rack deployments.

  • High-speed interconnects (InfiniBand/RoCE), RAID/storage (NVMe/SAS/SATA), vendor tooling (iDRAC/iLO/IPMI).

  • Automation (Python/Bash) for ops tooling and reporting; ticketing (Jira/ServiceNow), inventory/RMA flows.

  • Hardware qualification, burn-in or factory validation background.

What We Offer

Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

jobs.description:
Senior Software Engineer - Customer Platform

Why loveholidays?

We’re on a mission to open the world to everyone, giving our customers unlimited choice, unmatched ease and unmissable value for their next getaway.

Our trailblaze together culture is what drives our success, powered by our people and the way they work. Using progressive technology, we drive cutting-edge innovation and improve how our customers discover, book and experience their holidays. You’ll have the opportunity to accelerate your growth through meaningful challenges, new experiences and the freedom to shape your own path. You’ll create impact for our future by taking ownership, contributing to shared goals and helping shape what comes next, all as part of our enhanced international community of talented, collaborative and passionate teams.

Why Technology at loveholidays

Technology at loveholidays underpins our vision to become the most loved OTA in Europe. We drive cutting-edge innovation and technical excellence to futureproof the business. Our systems process trillions of daily holiday offers, we deploy over a thousand times a month, serving thousands of requests per second. This is where you can accelerate your growth by solving complex challenges and broadening your skillset.

Join us to create impact for our future in an exciting new chapter, owning your success and contributing to shared goals. We actively talk about technology and adhere to our key technology principles that have guided us this far. We are growing and have ambitious plans to expand across Europe, employing the best minds and technology to let us do this.

The difference you’ll make

You’ll sit in the Discover and Book team, reporting to the Lead Software Engineer. You’ll work closely with our product and design teams to help shape fast, accessible and reliable experiences for customers. You’ll work on high-impact journeys across search, discovery and booking, helping customers find and book their next holiday across web and mobile, while continuing to evolve our frontend platform and keep us at the forefront of modern web engineering.

You’ll create polished, high-performing customer experiences that make finding and booking a holiday simple and trustworthy. You’ll bring strong product and engineering judgement to the team, balancing speed of delivery with accessibility, performance, consistency and long-term maintainability.

Discover and Book sits within our Customer Platform function, which builds the technology and shared capabilities that power the loveholidays experience. By creating scalable products, systems and tools, Platform helps the wider organisation move faster, work more independently and deliver better outcomes for customers.

You will:

  • Build modern, responsive web experiences that are fast, accessible, reliable and maintainable.

  • Work closely with Product and Design to turn customer problems into simple, intuitive journeys.

  • Raise the quality bar for UI by ensuring experiences are accessible, visually consistent and work well across devices, browsers, languages and European markets.

  • Build and evolve customer journeys that work seamlessly across the web and our iOS and Android app, accounting for the behaviours and constraints of each platform.

  • Evolve our design system, shared components and design tokens so teams can build consistent experiences quickly.

  • Improve web performance, including page load speed, rendering, bundle size and Core Web Vitals.

  • Use experimentation, analytics and customer insight to make informed product decisions.

  • Build well-tested, observable features and use production signals to continuously improve them.

  • Collaborate with backend engineers on APIs and data contracts, keeping data ownership clear and frontend integrations straightforward.

  • Mentor other engineers through pairing, code review and pragmatic technical guidance.

  • Contribute to our frontend migration, bringing customer journeys from our established application onto our modern shared frontend platform.

Your day-to-day:

  • Deliver customer-facing features iteratively, using experimentation and customer insight to validate ideas and improve outcomes.

  • Partner with engineers, designers, product managers and analysts within and beyond your team.

  • Build and maintain reusable UI components, patterns and tooling.

  • Validate customer experiences across web, iOS and Android.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

About the role

We are looking for a backend-leaning full-stack engineer to help build the next generation of Creative Agents at ElevenLabs.

Our ambition is to make agents a primary way people create across ElevenCreative. We are building systems that turn ideas into high-quality audio, image and video, bringing models and creative tools together without requiring users to become prompting experts.

The creative agent is already live. You will join a small team shaping its capabilities and architecture, with ownership from backend systems and agent infrastructure through to the customer-facing experience. You will help discover what works, turn experiments into reliable features, and use real customer feedback to guide what we build next.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Building production agents and expanding their capabilities through prompts, tool use, orchestration, new models and MCP integrations.

  • Designing and operating reliable backend systems for asynchronous creative generation and long-running tasks, with strong performance, observability, scalability and security.

  • Developing shared evaluations and live quality monitoring, including model-based assessment of image and video outputs.

  • Owning features end to end, from identifying user needs and prototyping to shipping across the stack and supporting them in production, alongside product, design and engineering.

You will help shape both what the agent can do and how people use it across ElevenCreative. The work combines substantial greenfield development with improving and operating a live product.

Requirements

We care about evidence of exceptional engineering: products you have shipped, difficult problems you have solved, and systems you have owned.

We are looking for:

  • Strong backend engineering skills, experience operating production systems, and sound fundamentals in APIs, cloud infrastructure, storage and asynchronous processing.

  • Hands-on experience developing agents, with an understanding of prompts, tools, execution logic, evaluations and the challenges of reliable, secure operation.

  • Evidence of independent, end-to-end ownership and confidence working across the stack, including frontend delivery when needed.

  • Good product judgement, clear communication and enthusiasm for creative agents.

We may also consider exceptional engineers with closely relevant experience. Familiarity with HTTP, WebSockets and asynchronous workers will help you build reliable communication between services and recover from failures.

Experience with multimodal generation, creative editors, MCP, or building products in a small, fast-moving team would be particularly valuable.

That's your world.
As a Data Center Facilities Operations Technician at our Lauterbourg site, you are the person who makes sure the lights stay on. You know your facility better than anyone: every cable tray, every cooling unit, every alarm.
You monitor and maintain our complete infrastructure: electrical systems from MV/LV distribution to grounding, UPS systems kept tested and ready and HVAC/cooling systems that keep everything running at optimal temperature and efficiency.

Also it’s important that you have fun to pass your knowledge on to our technicians in the team.

To be honest: there's never been a more exciting time to join us. We're not just maintaining a data center; we're still in the process building one hall. jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Platform Engineer
Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning
 
Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature-rich solution, empowering every team—from Finance to HR—to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.
 
Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally. Industry leaders like Unilever, Snowflake, Siemens, and DPD use Pigment daily to make more informed decisions and confidently navigate any scenario.
 
With a team of 600+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, we've raised nearly $400M from top-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software.
 
At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo—all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

The opportunity

 

We are looking for a Senior Platform Engineer profile who will design and implement the Pigment infrastructure for tomorrow. Pigment is a technically challenging platform. It calculates and synchronizes large datasets that must be updated in real-time. Data comes from client models that can be up to billions of rows. This data can be pivoted, transformed, and aggregated on-demand through our formula engine while rendering live on our front end.

Here are the challenges to be tackled as a Senior Platform Engineer:

  • Define and build the infrastructure needed to answer our performance challenges, automate it, and make it scalable. In particular, ensure that the infrastructure scales in and out according to the platform usage.
  • Secure high availability and redundancy of the Pigment platform.
  • Ensure that the platform’s performance and correctness are monitored accordingly, spread observability best practices across the engineering team.
  • Participate in incident response.
  • Accompany Pigment geographical expansion as the company grows and we sign clients overseas.
  • Work with our security team on the implementation of their roadmap when related to infrastructure and development pipelines (code repository, credentials management, ...)
  • Continuously chase inefficiencies within our development practices and pipelines. Seek improvement and automation wherever possible. Drive change across the software engineering team.

In addition to Platform responsibilities, we expect you to contribute to software development activities. This is not limited to scripting and automations - we expect to you to be fully capable of reading and writing code. We believe Senior Platform Engineers should collaborate closely with software engineers, fostering a shared understanding of day-to-day challenges, rather than operating in separate teams. Last but not least, you will not be alone! You will be part of an SRE team.

 

Our Engineering team

Our Engineering team is responsible for developing our SaaS platform and building a comprehensive and user-friendly product.

Pigment engineers participate in the entire application development lifecycle, focusing on design, coding, and keeping the production platform up and running. They can be specialized, but there is no strict separation between the infrastructure, backend, and the frontend.

 

We value user-centricity and pragmatism: we choose the most relevant tools for the problem we have to solve, understanding the strengths and constraints of each technology.

Our engineering culture also values curiosity, humility, trust, ownership and team spirit.

  • Kubernetes (GKE, hosted on Google Cloud Platform): hosting all our infrastructure components except some PostgreSQL hosts, hosted on Google Cloud SQL

jobs.description:
Member of Technical Staff, North Modelling (Evals)

Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Role overview:

North is Cohere’s AI workspace platform for enterprises: a secure, customizable environment where companies can use AI across their real workflows while maintaining control over sensitive data. North connects AI agents with workplace tools, applications, and business context, helping users delegate complex work, build automations, inspect outputs, and collaborate with AI in production environments.

As North becomes more capable, one of the most important questions is also one of the hardest: how do we know whether the model is actually getting better for the workflows customers care about?

This role is about being the voice of North inside modelling. You will build the evaluation systems, feedback loops, and applied modelling workflows that make sure model progress translates into better product outcomes for North users. You will work closely with North product teams, customer-facing teams, and modelling teams to define what “good” means across the product surface, turn real usage and product direction into high-quality evals, and use those evals to guide model selection, patches, and regular model updates.

This is neither a pure research role nor a conventional product engineering role. It is a rigorous applied MLE role for someone who cares deeply about measurement, model behavior, and real-world product quality. You should be excited by the craft of building careful evals: evals that capture messy agentic workflows, reflect actual customer needs, resist superficial benchmark hacking, and provide useful signal for where the product and models need to go next.

  • Build high-quality evals from the realities of the product: user feedback, production failures, privacy-preserving usage logs, internal dogfooding, customer needs, and forward-looking product goals.

  • Create systems that continuously turn what North is learning from users, customers, and feature teams into evals, so measurement keeps pace with the product rather than becoming a static benchmark.

  • Be the voice of North inside modelling: extract clear insight from eval results, customer-derived data and product context, then turn model failures, capability gaps, and North-specific needs into actionable recommendations for the central modelling teams.

Qualifications:

  • You care deeply about evaluation as a craft: representative tasks, precise rubrics, clean data, failure analysis, regression tracking, and knowing when a metric is giving false confidence.

  • You have strong applied MLE judgment and can reason clearly about model behavior, eval validity, product outcomes, and production tradeoffs.

  • You are comfortable working close to users and product teams, while translating messy qualitative signals into measurement that other modelling teams can act on.

  • You are self-directed, practical, and motivated by open-ended problems where the right answer requires both technical depth and product understanding.

  • You care about making AI systems genuinely useful in real enterprise settings, not just better on abstract benchmarks.

Synthesia ships more product, faster, than we ever have. AI has collapsed the cost of building which means the hard part is no longer making things, it’s making sure people actually adopt them. We’re hiring a Growth Product Manager to report to our VP of Growth. You'll own the Growth surface for one of those bets while helping build a growth-led way of working across the company.

  • Own Growth for a core product area end to end, acquisition, activation, adoption and retention, baked into the roadmap from the start, not retrofitted.

  • Partner closely with the core product PMs and engineers who own the surface, bringing high-impact growth ideas and working out where they fit, and getting the primitives exposed that let you build and scale on top.

  • Design growth into the product itself: discovery-led acquisition loops, and experiences that get users to their job-to-be-done in a couple of clicks (sometimes without opening the editor at all).

  • Rally teams around specific, measurable outcomes and help each one hit its goal faster through what you build together.

  • Work across engineering, marketing and GTM to make funnel- and journey-thinking a normal part of how we build.

Who you are

  • AI-native. You’ve driven AI into how a product or team works - not just worked somewhere that does AI. You use it daily, you’re curious about how the stack works, and you keep up as it moves (fast).

  • Scrappy and comfortable in ambiguity. You’ve taken something 0→1, you move fast, and you don’t need a clean brief or a stable roadmap to make progress. Constant change energises you rather than blocking you.

  • A builder of credibility. You win trust across teams quickly and can get engineers, PMs and GTM aligned around growth - even when that’s a new way of working for them.

Remote from Europe or hybrid based from our London or Munich offices.

Notre logiciel tout-en-un simplifie la prise de rendez-vous, les paiements et la gestion client, permettant ainsi aux professionnels de se concentrer sur l'essentiel : délivrer une prestation exceptionnelle. Nous sommes fiers de façonner l'avenir de l'industrie de la beauté grâce à l'innovation, la collaboration et une approche résolument humaine.

Après avoir digitalisé le secteur de la beauté dans plusieurs pays d'Europe, nous recherchons nos premiers commerciaux pour faire de la France une de nos plus grandes réussites.

Tes missions

  • Maîtrise du cycle de vente (A à Z) : tu pilotes l'intégralité du parcours d'acquisition de nouveaux clients pour Salonkee. Cela inclut la chasse initiale, la prise de rendez-vous qualifiés, la réalisation de démonstrations percutantes et le closing des contrats.

  • Conseil stratégique & optimisation : tu accompagnes tes prospects avec expertise en leur proposant des solutions digitales sur mesure pour optimiser leurs processus et libérer tout leur potentiel de croissance.

  • Stratégie multicanale : tu utilises différents canaux de communication pour approcher les clients potentiels et développer des relations de confiance durables.

  • Accompagnement & formation : tu assures la formation de tes nouveaux clients pour garantir une adoption parfaite de l'outil et un succès immédiat dès le premier jour d'utilisation.

Ton profil

  • Expérience sales : pas besoin d'un CV parfait; ce qu'on cherche avant tout, c'est quelqu'un avec la fibre commerciale et le drive pour aller chercher le client. Une première expérience en vente terrain B2B ou en prospection téléphone/physique est un vrai atout: tu sais ce que c'est que d'aller chercher le client là où il est

  • Tempérament chasseur : tu as le goût du challenge, une résilience à toute épreuve et une appétence naturelle pour la prospection active

  • Autonomie & organisation : véritable self-starter, tu planifies tes journées de façon stratégique et trouves les meilleurs leviers pour établir Salonkee dans ton secteur

  • Excellent relationnel : tu sais instaurer une confiance immédiate et créer un lien fort avec des entrepreneurs indépendants

  • Digital native : tu es à l'aise avec les outils SaaS et les environnements tech: la maîtrise d'un CRM est un vrai plus.

  • Mobilité : le permis B est indispensable. Tu gères en totale autonomie la région de Strasbourg.

  • Langues : français natif. Un anglais professionnel est apprécié pour collaborer avec nos équipes internationales.

Ce que nous offrons

  • Un salaire fixe entre 28.000 € et 34.000 € brut annuel + variable déplafonné (OTE cible : 39.000 € – 45.000 €). Ton succès, ton revenu

  • Véhicule de fonction + carte essence + badge télépéage

  • Organisation autonome. Tu gères ton agenda dans un cadre de confiance

  • 25 jours de congés + repos supplémentaire (sous conditions)

  • Mutuelle

  • Tickets-restaurant

  • Un parcours d'intégration structuré : formation produit, accompagnement terrain avec ton manager les premières semaines, et accès à l'expérience de nos équipes déjà en place dans 6 autres pays

  • Un accès direct au leadership et une vraie capacité d'influence sur la stratégie commerciale dès tes premiers mois

  • L'opportunité de participer à une success story et d'avoir un impact tangible sur l'avenir du secteur de la beauté et du bien-être

  • Des événements d'entreprise réguliers pour renforcer la cohésion d'équipe et créer des opportunités de networking et de collaboration

Chez Salonkee, nous sommes convaincus que l'innovation s'épanouit dans un environnement où chacun se sent inclus et valorisé. Nous bâtissons une équipe diversifiée à l'image de l'industrie que nous servons : créative, passionnée et riche de perspectives variées. Peu importe qui tu es ou d'où tu viens, tu trouveras ici ta place pour grandir, contribuer et être toi-même.

Salonkee promeut l'égalité des chances et la diversité. Nous accueillons toutes les candidatures, indépendamment du genre, de l'origine, de l'âge, du handicap ou de l'identité.

Responsable Comptable Process & outils - CDI (H/F/X)
Pionnier des ventes événementielles en ligne depuis 2001 et acteur incontournable du e-commerce en Europe, Veepee collabore avec plus de 7 000 marques pour proposer des produits à forte décote, disponibles sur une durée limitée. Présent dans de nombreux univers parmi lesquels la mode, la maison, le vin, le voyage, ou encore la beauté ... Veepee a réalisé en 2024 un chiffre d’affaires de 3,3 milliards d’euros TTC et compte 5 000 collaborateurs répartis dans 10 pays.

📄 DESCRIPTION DU POSTE

Nous recherchons un Responsable Comptable Process & Outils passionné, prêt à transformer nos opérations comptables au sein de notre équipe. Ce rôle stratégique combine une expertise comptable pointue avec des compétences en gestion de projet et en leadership, afin de piloter l'optimisation et la fiabilisation de nos processus et outils, notamment sur les périmètres de la comptabilité fournisseurs (BP et IP) et des stocks.


🎯 MISSIONS

En tant que pilier de l'amélioration continue, vous serez au cœur de l'évolution de nos pratiques comptables. Vos responsabilités principales incluront :

Activité 1 : Pilotage de Projets Process & Outils

  • Concevoir et déployer une feuille de route ambitieuse pour les projets d'optimisation, en étroite collaboration avec nos équipes Tech. ; que ce soit dans le développement de nos outils, comme dans  l’intégration de l’IA dans nos process

  • Analyser les besoins, définir les processus cibles et mener l'automatisation des flux pour une efficacité maximale.

  • Diriger en autonomie les projets d'évolution et de développement de nos outils comptables, en alignement avec les objectifs de la Direction Financière.

    • Activité 2 :Optimisation et Fiabilisation des Processus Comptables 

  • Identifier et analyser les pistes d'amélioration, en proposant des solutions innovantes (IA ou développement d’outils)

  • Garantir la bonne application des process et booster la performance des équipes grâce à des flux optimisés.

  • Mettre en place des outils ou solutions garantissant l'application rigoureuse des procédures et schémas comptables en vigueur dans le département.

  • Être le référent clé pour les audits internes et externes, garantissant une conformité irréprochable.

    • Activité 3:  Management et développement de l’équipe 

  • Manager, animer et faire grandir une équipe dédiée à l'accompagnement du changement, à la formation et au support fonctionnel.

  • Développer les compétences de vos collaborateurs à travers la formation et une montée en puissance structurée.

  • Mettre en place et suivre des reportings et des KPI comptables pertinents pour une visibilité complète de l'activité.

    • Activité 4 : Support, Conformité et Qualité

  • Mettre à jour et diffuser les modes opératoires et supports, assurant une base de connaissances à jour.

  • Assurer la formation et le support quotidien des équipes (présentiel et à distance) pour une autonomie renforcée.

  • Formaliser et implémenter des contrôles opérationnels (RIB, PO, etc.) et les schémas comptables.

  • Définir et superviser les actions correctives nécessaires suite aux contrôles ou audits.


    • 👉 PRÉ REQUIS

    Formation & Expérience :

  • Diplôme supérieur en Comptabilité (BAC+2 minimum), socle indispensable de votre expertise.
  • Minimum 5 ans d'expérience en comptabilité, dont une première expérience managériale où vous avez déjà démontré votre capacité à encadrer et inspirer.
  • Une expérience confirmée en gestion de projet sera un atout majeur pour mener nos initiatives d'optimisation.

    • Compétences Techniques :

  • Maîtrise indispensable des principes et techniques comptables.
  • Forte appétence pour les outils informatiques et les ERP comptables ; la connaissance de SAP est un atout majeur.
  • Une première expérience avec l'Intelligence Artificielle (IA) serait un plus, témoignant de votre curiosité pour l'innovation.
  • Anglais courant indispensable pour échanger dans notre contexte international.

    • Qualités Personnelles :

  • Vous savez prendre de la hauteur pour développer une approche macro et stratégique.
  • Communicant hors pair, doté d'une forte aisance relationnelle et de qualités pédagogiques avérées pour transmettre et fédérer.
  • Curieux, organisé, rigoureux et respectueux des délais, vous excellez dans la gestion proactive de vos missions.
  • Un esprit d'équipe prononcé et une capacité naturelle à fédérer autour d'objectifs communs.

    • ✅ AVANTAGES

    👉 Prime variable 

    👉 Participation aux bénéfices et plan d'intéressement 

    👉Bureau flexible avec au minimum 3 jours sur place et jusqu'à 2 jours à domicile.

    👉Plate-forme d'apprentissage des langues en ligne 

    👉Entreprise comité (CE)

    👉Assurance maladie

    👉Vacances (ex : CP & RTT)

jobs.description:
Gestionnaire comptable

ENSTA, établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche classé dans le Top 10 des meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France, recrute un ou une Gestionnaire financier et comptable (F/H).

ENSTA, établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées, développe des activités de formation, de recherche et d’innovation dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et de la santé.

L’école, présente sur deux campus, à Paris-Saclay et à Brest, est membre de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Classée dans le Top 10 des meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France, elle a pour mission :

  • la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, de cadres et docteurs pour les secteurs public et privé

  • la recherche et l’innovation de haut niveau en relation étroite avec l’industrie des grands secteurs de souveraineté au sein de 6 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR).

 

Le/la titulaire du poste sera affecté au sein de l’Agence comptable. Ce service comprend cinq personnels. Il a pour vocation de participer à la tenue de la comptabilité générale, procéder aux paiements et aux encaissements et contrôler les opérations budgétaires.

La/le titulaire du poste sera affecté, sur le Campus de Brest ou le Campus de Paris-Saclay.

 

Missions / Activités principales :

Sous l’autorité de l’agent comptable, le/la titulaire du poste a pour missions de :

 

  • Assurer le visa des recettes

  • Procéder aux relances et au recouvrement des recettes

  • Assurer le visa de la paye

 

Missions / Activité annexe :

  • Assurer le visa de la dépense

  • Procéder au suivi et au remboursement des cautions

  • Contribuer à toute activité du service en fonction des priorités retenues.

  • Contribuer à la démarche Qualité, notamment via la rédaction et la mise à jour des procédures, le renseignement et le suivi des indicateurs

  • Contribuer à la démarche RSE de l’Ecole dans le cadre de ses missions et de ses activités

  • Participer aux travaux préparatoires de contrôle interne comptable (CIC)

 

L’équipe de l’Agence comptable étant bilocalisée, des trajets entre Paris-Saclay et Brest seront à prévoir dans le cadre des activités du service.

Niveau de diplôme et formations

Niveau de formation et/ou expérience requis :

BAC + 2, avec une expérience similaire

 

Emploi

  • Fonctionnaire de catégorie B

  • Agent contractuel (emploi pérenne ; CDD de 1 à 3 ans renouvelable) CDI possible après 18 mois de CDD

Durée d’affectation souhaitée : 3 à 5 ans

Date de prise de fonctions prévue : mars 2027

Rémunération :

  • Fonctionnaires : selon les conditions statutaires (grille indiciaire, IFSE, CIA)

  • Contractuels : en fonction de l'expérience professionnelle sur des postes de niveau équivalent

Lieu de travail :

ENSTA Campus Paris-Saclay, 828 boulevard des Maréchaux 91762 Palaiseau – Cedex ou Campus de Brest, 2 rue François Verny 29200 Brest.

« Les sites sont accessibles en voiture (parking pour le personnel) ou en transports en commun. L’Ecole étant engagée dans une démarche RSE (DD-RS et employeur pro-vélo), elle encourage aux mobilités douces par la mise en place de dispositif d’aide financière (FMD) et des infrastructures adaptées aux cyclistes »

Poste à temps complet (39h hebdomadaires, 25 jours de congés annuels, 23 RTT annuels)

Avantages :

  • Transports (participation forfaitaire de l’employeur à hauteur de 75 %)

  • Forfait mobilité durable (jusqu’à 300€/an)

  • Possibilité de télétravail (après accord du manager et dépôt d’une demande)

  • Subvention employeur au restaurant administratif et/ou à la cafétéria de l’établissement

  • Comité d’action sociale, avec notamment des événements et animations proposés au personnel, salle de sport sur adhésion, centre de loisirs pour les enfants du personnel à partir de 6 ans avec tarifs préférentiels

  • Mutuelle (participation à hauteur de 50% de l’établissement)

Aménagement du poste de travail et recrutement inclusif :

Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux candidats en situation de handicap.

ENSTA s’engage à un recrutement favorisant l’égalité, la diversité et l’inclusion. Toutes les candidatures sans aucune distinction (âge, handicap, sexe, nationalité, religion, orientation sexuelle…) ont leur place dans notre processus de recrutement.

 

Présentation de l’Ecole

 

ENSTA est membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris). Dans le cadre d’IP Paris, l’école participe aux activités des centres interdisciplinaires notamment du centre interdisciplinaire d'études pour la Défense et la Sécurité (CIEDS, soutenu par le ministère des armées et l’agence de l’innovation de défense (AID). Elle est à l’origine de la création du Centre interdisciplinaire Mers & Océans, inauguré en janvier 2025. Des chercheurs de l’école travaillent également en collaboration dans le cadre d'études portées par les centres Hi-Paris, lauréat en 2024 IA Cluster, E4C ou E4H notamment.

 

ENSTA résulte de la fusion le 1er janvier 2025 d’ENSTA Paris et d’ENSTA Bretagne. Son siège est situé à Palaiseau (91), sur le campus de Paris-Saclay et elle a un autre campus à Brest.

 

Rejoindre l'école, c'est intégrer un établissement engagé pour la parité et l'égalité professionnelle, la diversité et l'accompagnement de ses agents en situation de handicap, dès le recrutement et tout au long de la carrière. Afin de préserver le bien-être au travail, l'école mène une politique active en matière de conditions de travail, reposant notamment sur un juste équilibre entre vie personnelle et vie professionnelle.


            Connaissances :

  • Comptabilité publique en GBCP selon l’Instruction Comptable Commune (ICC)

Savoir-faire :

  • Suivi administratif des dossiers, en particulier dans le cadre du recouvrement

  • Visa des pièces transmises par l’ordonnateur

  • Mise en œuvre des projets de CIC

 

Savoir être :

  • Rigueur

  • Secret professionnel

  • Partage de l’information

jobs.description:
Graphic Designer 100% (a)
Über uns

Die Hotz Group ist ein markenorientierter Partner für Wertschöpfung, der Unternehmen an strategischen Wendepunkten neue Zukunft gestaltet und aufbaut. Wir arbeiten mit Investoren, Inhabern und dem Top-Management – von unserem Hauptsitz in der Schweiz und unseren Standorten in Los Angeles, Singapur, Hamburg und Neu-Delhi.
 
Zu unseren Kunden zählen inhabergeführte Unternehmen, nationale und Hidden Champions sowie grosse internationale Konzerne.
 
Aufbau integriertes Kreativ-Team 
Wir befinden uns in einer Phase der Weiterentwicklung und bauen unsere kreativen Kompetenzen gezielt aus. Im Zuge dessen entwickeln wir ein schlagkräftiges Design-Team an der Schnittstelle von Geschäftsstrategie, Marke und Design. Das Team arbeitet künftig für alle Unternehmen der Gruppe, mehr dazu findest du auch auf https://Hotz.studio. 
 
Unser Anspruch ist es dabei, strategisches und unternehmerisches Denken mit exzellenter kreativer und gestalterischer Arbeit zu verbinden. Wir verstehen Strategie und Design nicht als getrennte Disziplinen, sondern als gegenseitige Enabler, die für Unternehmen und Marken nachhaltig Wert schaffen. Für unser Kreativ-Team suchen wir nach Kandidaten, die diesen Weg aktiv mitgestalten möchten.
 
Gemeinsames Verständnis von Zusammenarbeit
Gesucht werden Persönlichkeiten, die sich gerne in ein dynamisches Umfeld einbringen und Freude daran haben, gemeinsam mit anderen Talenten Lösungen zu entwickeln, die die Erwartungen an eine klassische Agentur übertreffen. Wichtig sind uns eine agile, unkomplizierte und pragmatische Arbeitsweise, Eigeninitiative sowie ein ausgeprägter Teamgedanke. Wir arbeiten auf Augenhöhe – unabhängig von Funktion oder Hierarchie. Wir suchen Menschen, die offen kommunizieren, Wissen teilen, Feedback konstruktiv aufnehmen und auch andere Perspektiven aktiv einbeziehen.


Über die Stelle

Als Graphic Designer arbeitest du an Branding-Projekten, visuellen Identitäten und digitalen Anwendungen. Du entwickelst visuelle Systeme präzise weiter, wendest Marken konsistent über unterschiedliche Touchpoints hinweg an und arbeitest eng mit Art Directors, Strateg:innen und Berater:innen zusammen. Im Mittelpunkt steht deine gestalterische Qualität – gleichzeitig interessierst du dich für die Inhalte und strategischen Zusammenhänge hinter dem Design.

On-site, 1–2 Tage Homeoffice möglich


Deine Aufgaben

  • Ausarbeitung und Weiterentwicklung von visuellen Identitäten, Corporate Designs und Designsystemen
  • Gestaltung und Weiterentwicklung von Logos, Logo-Systemen, Brand Guidelines, Typografie- und Farbsystemen sowie Bildwelten
  • Entwicklung digitaler Markenanwendungen, insbesondere Websites, Responsive Designs und digitale Designsysteme
  • Gestaltung von Kommunikationsmitteln und Markenanwendungen über Touchpoints wie Web, Social Media, Kampagne, Motion und Print
  • Präzise Umsetzung von Designkonzepten und Sicherstellung einer konsistenten visuellen Markenführung
  • Zusammenarbeit mit Art Directors, Strateg:innen und Berater:innen bei der Entwicklung starker und umsetzbarer Lösungen
  • Einbringen eigener Ideen und aktives Mitdenken bei kreativen und gestalterischen Fragestellungen
  • Aufbereitung und Präsentation von Entwürfen und Varianten im Team sowie gegebenenfalls gegenüber Kund:innen
  • Aktive Nutzung und Weiterentwicklung deiner Kenntnisse in Figma, Adobe Creative Suite und neuen Design-Tools
  • Bereitschaft, dich in strategische und unternehmerische Zusammenhänge einzuarbeiten und zur Weiterentwicklung des Kreativ-Teams beizutragen


Dein Profil

  • Ca. 3–6 Jahre Berufserfahrung
  • Sehr starkes, designorientiertes Portfolio mit überzeugenden Branding-, Website- und Digitalprojekten
  • Zwingende Erfahrung im Bereich Branding, Corporate Design und Visual Identities
  • Erfahrung mit Logoentwicklung, Designsystemen, Brand Guidelines, Typografie, Farbsystemen und Bildwelten
  • Sehr gutes Verständnis dafür, wie eine Marke vom Logo und Grundsystem bis zur digitalen Anwendung funktioniert

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
Executive Assistant

This is Cradle

Proteins are the molecular machines of life, used for many therapeutic, diagnostic, chemical, agricultural and food applications. Designing and optimizing proteins takes a lot of expert knowledge and manual effort, through the use of custom computational and biological tools.

Machine learning is revolutionizing this space, by enabling high-fidelity protein models. At Cradle, we offer a software platform for AI-guided discovery and optimization of proteins, so that biologists can design proteins faster and at scale. We are already used by clients across biopharma, biotech, agri-tech, food-tech, and academia.

We're an experienced team of just under 100 people. We've built many successful products before and have enough funding for multiple years of runway. We are distributed across three offices in Amsterdam, Boston, and Zurich, alongside a few remote colleagues.

We offer our employees a very competitive salary, a generous equity stake in the company and a wide range of benefits and career progression opportunities.

The Role

As Executive Assistant at Cradle, you'll keep two of our founding executives moving. Between customer visits, investor meetings, hiring and travel across Amsterdam, Zurich and the US, there's a lot to keep track of, and your job is to make sure nothing gets dropped. You'll own their calendars, inboxes and travel, and take care of the personal admin that would otherwise eat into their time. This role suits someone who likes being trusted with the whole picture, professional and personal, and treats both with the same care.

Responsibilities

  • Run two calendars as one system: Protect focus time, balance competing priorities across time zones, and decide what deserves a meeting and what can be an email.

  • Own the inbox front line: Triage, draft and reply on their behalf to customers, investors, candidates and the team, so the important things surface and the rest gets handled.

  • Plan travel end to end: Customer visits, conferences and trips between Amsterdam, Zurich and the US, from flights and hotels to the meeting room and dinner booking on the other side.

  • Take care of personal and life admin: Appointments, household logistics, official paperwork, bills and renewals, handled so none of it lands on their desks.

  • Prepare every important meeting: Make sure briefs and context are ready beforehand, and follow up on decisions and action items afterwards.

  • Make recurring admin disappear: Automate repeated processes so they mostly run themselves.

Requirements

The best people we've hired didn't match a checklist. Below is a list of what matters most for this role. If you bring most of it and are curious about the rest, we'd love to hear from you:

  • 4+ years supporting senior executives, ideally more than one at a time

  • Sharp judgment about what's urgent, what can wait and what never needs to reach the exec

  • Clear, polished written English

  • You spot the next problem before anyone asks and fix it

  • Experience handling personal admin alongside the professional side, with the discretion that comes with it

  • Organised and dependable without needing a rigid structure; at a ~90-person company you'll often build the process yourself

  • At home in Google Workspace and quick to pick up new software tools

Nice to Haves

These aren't requirements, but they'd give you a head start:

  • German fluency would be idea to would make local appointments, paperwork and authorities much easier

  • Experience in a startup or scale-up environment

  • Familiarity with Swiss administrative procedures (permits, insurance, tax paperwork, relocations)

  • Experience with task tools like Todoist, Notion or Linear
